title: Add Cadence Zones System
description: Implement CadenceZones struct following the existing PowerZones and HRZones patterns. Cadence zones track optimal cadence ranges for different training objectives (recovery, endurance, tempo climbing, high-cadence drills). Include zone tracking and change events similar to ZoneTracker's power/HR zone change detection.

phases.name: Core Cadence Zone Types
phases.description: Define CadenceZoneRange and CadenceZones structs following existing patterns

subtasks.title: Define CadenceZoneRange struct
subtasks.description: Create CadenceZoneRange struct in zones.rs with zone number, min/max RPM, color, and name fields. Follow the HRZoneRange pattern.
acceptance_criteria: CadenceZoneRange struct with zone: u8, min_rpm: u8, max_rpm: u8, color: Color, name: String
subtasks.notes: Created CadenceZoneRange struct in zones.rs following HRZoneRange pattern. Struct includes zone: u8, min_rpm: u8, max_rpm: u8, color: Color, name: String fields. Derives Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize. Committed as cb9a710.

subtasks.title: Define CADENCE_ZONE_COLORS constant
subtasks.description: Create 5-color array for cadence zones. Use distinct colors that don't conflict with power/HR zone colors.
acceptance_criteria: Colors are distinct and appropriate for each zone meaning
subtasks.notes: Added CADENCE_ZONE_COLORS constant in zones.rs with 5 distinct colors: Steel Blue (120,160,180), Cyan (0,180,200), Teal (0,170,150), Orchid (200,100,180), Hot Pink (255,50,180). Uses a cyan/teal to magenta progression distinct from power and HR zone color schemes. Committed as 1538a0b.

subtasks.title: Define CadenceZones struct
subtasks.description: Create 5-zone CadenceZones struct with zones for: Low (recovery/climbing), Economy, Natural, Fast, and Sprint cadence ranges.
acceptance_criteria: CadenceZones struct with z1_low, z2_economy, z3_natural, z4_fast, z5_sprint zones

subtasks.title: Implement CadenceZones::default()
subtasks.description: Implement Default trait with standard cadence zone boundaries (60-75, 76-85, 86-95, 96-105, 106+).
acceptance_criteria: Default implementation returns standard 5-zone cadence model
Each zone has appropriate name and color

subtasks.title: Implement CadenceZones methods
subtasks.description: Implement get_zone(), get_zone_range(), and all_zones() methods following PowerZones/HRZones patterns.
